Introduction
This study examines how people evaluate AI-generated explanations for approval or denial of loan applications.

Background and Purpose of the Study
AI systems are increasingly being used in credit risk assessment for loan applications, where fairness, transparency, and trust are critical. While these systems generate explanations for their decisions, little is known about how users perceive different explanation types.

This study evaluates explanation styles based on understandability, clarity, trustworthiness, and satisfaction. By collecting user ratings across formats, it identifies which approaches best support user comprehension and confidence in AI-driven credit decisions.

What Will Happen During the Study
You will review AI-generated credit risk explanations and rate them on qualities such as understandability, trustworthiness, and insightfulness. The survey consists of one required round, with up to two additional optional rounds (3 rounds total). Each round includes 4 explanations. Explanation types are assigned at random. The duration is approximately 5–10 minutes per round.

This online study is hosted on Qualtrics. You can review the privacy policy here: https://www.qualtrics.com/privacy-statement/.

Inclusion Criteria
You must be 18 years of age or older to participate. There are no other inclusion or exclusion criteria.

Risks and Benefits
There are no known or anticipated risks associated with this study beyond those experienced in everyday life. While there are no direct benefits to you, your participation will help researchers better understand how individuals interpret AI-generated explanations in financial decision-making contexts.

Confidentiality
This study is anonymous. Responses cannot be linked to individuals, though you may optionally provide demographic information at the end. All responses will remain confidential and used solely for research. Results will be reported in aggregate and may appear in academic publications or a thesis.

Survey data will be securely stored on Qualtrics and may be accessed by authorized representatives of Western University’s ethics board for oversight. It will not be shared for open access or future research and will be destroyed after the study concludes. Within 1–2 days of survey closure, all data will be transferred to a secure Western University server, where it will be stored for a minimum of 5 years. Once the transfer is verified, data will be permanently deleted from Qualtrics. After the 5-year retention period, data will be securely destroyed.

To protect the quality and integrity of the data, the survey includes automated bot detection, reCAPTCHA, and attention checks. Responses that appear to be submitted by bots or that fail these checks may be excluded from analysis. No identifiable information is collected as part of this review process.


Voluntary Participation and Withdrawal
Your participation in this study is entirely voluntary. You may choose not to answer any question and may exit the survey after completing any round, before submitting your responses. Due to the anonymous nature of the data, once a round has been submitted, the responses from that round cannot be withdrawn. You do not waive any legal rights by participating in this study. You will not be re-contacted with updates or additional information during the course of the study.

Compensation
You will not be compensated for your participation in this study.
